source.how: The sheet is an ArcGIS Pro GeoPDF: each map frame carries a /VP viewport with its CRS (NAD_1983_HARN_StatePlane_Oregon_North_FIPS_3601, feet = EPSG:2913) and four corner coordinates. The page-to-ground affine was fitted to those corners (residual 0.31 ft at each) and the map's own vector strokes were read out of the page by colour, so nothing was rendered, picked or flood-filled. Checked by laying the county's current taxlots over the result: the ASC outlines and the setback strokes run on the lot and right-of-way lines. ASC 5 is the one closed outline Map 17 strokes in the ASC 5 green (RGB 0.22, 0.66, 0.00) over its hatch; it is stored as drawn (55.2 acres). The whole outline is the area: the text applies the ASC 5 requirements throughout the ASC, not only to lots facing the Park Blocks.
